facts.business: Engineers India Limited (EIL) is a globally recognised engineering, project management and integrated solutions company delivering projects across the hydrocarbon value chain, infrastructure, water, fertilisers, defence, nuclear, ports, mining, metallurgy and emerging energy segments such as biofuels, green hydrogen and green ammonia.
facts.related_party_note: The Audit Committee reviews related party transactions and grants omnibus approval subject to applicable provisions, reviewing details at least quarterly. The Company has joint operations CB-ONN-2010/11 (23.53%) and CB-ONN-2010/08 (22.22%) in India.
